_comment: The python x pytorch grid the prebuilt CI images are built for.
Single source of truth. build_ci_image.yml builds this set,
resolve_ci_image in ci_on_ubuntu.yml probes this set, and the test jobs
that run the full grid take their matrix from here.
Adding a pytorch version here is what makes an image exist for it.
ci/check_ci_image_config.py fails if a job asks for a variant this file
